local scn, done = ...
local function crate(pos, ang)
  local e = ents.Create("prop_physics") e:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
  e:SetPos(pos) e:SetAngles(ang or Angle(0,0,0)) e:Spawn() e:Activate() return e
end
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local g = crate(Vector(700, -500, -100))          -- gravity test
local b = crate(Vector(600, -500, -123.6))        -- collision: B on the floor, A above
local a = crate(Vector(600, -500, -40))
local k = crate(Vector(500, -500, -60), Angle(30, 0, 0))  -- keepupright, tilted in the air
local samples, t = {}, 0
local phase = 0
hook.Add("Think", "parity_lua_effects", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 60 then
    local pg = g:GetPhysicsObject() pg:EnableGravity(false) pg:Wake() pg:SetVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 50))
    b:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_WORLD)
    k.upright = constraint.Keepupright(k, Angle(0, 0, 0), 0, 999999)
    local pk = k:GetPhysicsObject() pk:EnableGravity(false) pk:Wake()
  end
  if t >= 55 and t <= 180 then
    samples[#samples + 1] = { t = t, g = { g:GetPos().z, g:GetPhysicsObject():GetVelocity().z },
      a = { a:GetPos().z, a:GetPhysicsObject():GetVelocity().z }, b_z = b:GetPos().z, b_group = b:GetCollisionGroup(),
      k = { k:GetAngles().p, k:GetAngles().y, k:GetAngles().r, k:GetPhysicsObject():GetAngleVelocity().y } }
  end
  if t == 181 then
    hook.Remove("Think", "parity_lua_effects")
    done({ samples = samples, upright_valid = IsValid(k.upright), upright_class = IsValid(k.upright) and k.upright:GetClass() or "",
      a_group = a:GetCollisionGroup(), world_group = COLLISION_GROUP_WORLD, none_group = COLLISION_GROUP_NONE })
  end
end)
return "async"
